input.goalText: Systems & Security: Systems & Security. Focus: Infrastructure & cloud. Wants to work: San Francisco / Bay Area. After graduating: Industry.

thoughts: You want to be a systems & Security, focused on infrastructure & cloud, working in the Bay Area, and heading into industry after graduating. That lines up with the department's Systems & Security track, so its electives come first.
Starting from semester 1 with calculus placement.
The longest prerequisite chain is CSC 101 → CSC 215 → CSC 220 → CSC 317 → CSC 413 → CSC 648, so CSC 101 has to start early.
Electives (15 units): CSC 615, CSC 645, CSC 651, CSC 652, CSC 653.
Keeping each semester near 15 units, under the 19-unit priority-registration cap.
raw.rationale: I matched "Systems & Security: Systems & Security. Focus: Infrastructure & cloud. Wants to work: San Francisco / Bay Area. After graduating: Industry." to Systems & Security and chose Embedded Linux Systems and Physical Computing, Computer Networks, System Administration and more, because they build directly on your core courses and point at that career.
